description: Diagnose any Microsoft problem from pasted text (error dialog, log lines, or a description): decodes every error code in it (Win32, HRESULT, NTSTATUS, blue screen, Entra AADSTS, Windows Update, CBS, MSI, Event IDs), finds the matching Microsoft support articles and live Microsoft Learn docs, and returns the likely cause, ranked fix steps with citations, commands labelled read-only or changes-the-system, a Microsoft outage check, Windows known issues for the version/KB, and which tenant tool to run next. Structured JSON for your AI to explain. Costs $0.02 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

product.description: Optional product hint: windows, entra, intune, outlook, teams, office, azure

text.description: The error message, code, log lines or problem description (up to 4000 characters)

windows_version.description: Optional Windows version, e.g. '11 24H2' or 'Server 2022' (auto-detected from text)

name: microsoft_diagnose
title: microsoft diagnose
